Bug_Details:
Using a collection function with itself as the argument. Invoking a collection method with the same collection as the argument is likely
incorrect. collection.addAll(collection) may cause an infinite loop, duplicate the
elements, or do nothing, depending on the type of Collection and
implementation class.
collection.retainAll(collection) is a no-op.
collection.removeAll(collection) is the same as collection.clear().
collection.containsAll(collection) is always true.
